function.name: geo_location_based_products_fetch_eco_friendly_products
function.description: Locate eco-friendly products near a specific geographic location based on product category and shopping preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Your city or the geographical location you're interested in shopping from. e.g., Seattle, WA

product_category.description: The category of product that you're interested in. e.g., Yoga Mats, Bamboo toothbrush, etc

availability.description: Your preferred method of getting the product - Instore, Online, or Both.

message.content:
好的！為了幫您找到符合需求的「GMO 瑜伽墊」並確保能在店內購買，請先告訴我：

1. 您所在的城市或想要購買的地點（例如：台北市、台中市、台南市等）。  
2. 您想要的產品是「不含基因改造成分」的瑜伽墊，還是「使用基因改造材料」的瑜伽墊？（如果是後者，請說明具體需求，例如材質或品牌偏好。）

有了這些資訊，我就能幫您搜尋附近可在店內購買的選項。期待您的回覆！
